description: Key an object's transform and shape keys into a named clip on an NLA track, exported as one glTF animation; a call replaces the object's keys in it. Returns: channels, frames, seconds, Godot warnings. WHEN TO CALL: for doors, rotors, morphs.

keys.description: {frame, location, rotation (degrees), scale, shape_key: {name: value}}; null skips an axis

loop.description: Repeat; default as Godot reads the name

name: animate_object
title: Animate Object
